summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the two new duplas_rotativas enhancements — (1) tied score requires manual winner selection with 'best campaign' suggestion, (2) mid-match retire-player that also disqualifies the current partner and excludes both from KO qualifiers. Backend: 7/7 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_rotating_retire.py — (a) PUT /api/matches/{id} 6/6 without winner keeps winner=None; (b) PUT 6/6 with winner='A' persists winner='A'; (c) POST /api/competitions/{cid}/matches/{mid}/retire-player {registration_id, reason:'contusao'} for a valid player returns {ok:true, retired:[player_rid, partner_rid]}, both regs have retired=true, partner has retired_by_partner=true and retired_partner_reg_id set; (d) bogus/unrelated registration_id → 400 'Jogador não faz parte desta partida'; (e) cross-tenant call → 404; (f) GET /rotating/leaderboard returns retired flags and sorts retired to bottom (verified last N rows are the retired regs); (g) POST /rotating/next-knockout-round with 2 retired players in one group of 4 correctly filters them out — remaining qualifiers do not include retired reg_ids in KO team source_registration_ids. Frontend (/admin/competicoes/{comp_id} on a seeded 8-player duplas_rotativas comp): filling 6/6 on [data-testid^='rot-match-'] renders the [data-testid^='tie-warn-'] banner 'Placar empatado — defina o vencedor', [data-testid^='rot-save-'] becomes disabled with label 'Defina o vencedor'; clicking [data-testid^='side-a-'] toggles winner=A and save re-enables with label 'Salvar placar'; clicking save persists to DB (verified: score_a=6, score_b=6, winner='A'). [data-testid^='tie-suggest-'] on a 5/5 tie triggers 'Campanhas empatadas' toast (both teams 0 campaign pts at tournament start) — no auto-pick, banner remains, save stays disabled — correct fallback. Retire flow: [data-testid^='retire-btn-'] opens [data-testid='retire-dialog']; selecting a player via [data-testid='retire-player-select'] (4 options rendered) with default reason=contusao and clicking [data-testid='retire-confirm'] shows toast '2 jogador(es) removidos do torneio'; leaderboard rows show line-through + red CONTUSÃO badge for the retired player and LEVADO PELO PARCEIRO badge for the partner; groups panel lists both retired players with strikethrough + red OUT badge.
critical_code_review_comments: retire_player endpoint has no idempotency guard: retiring the same player twice will still return ok:true and re-flag partner; consider early return if the reg already has retired=true, or block with 409 to prevent double-toasts on flaky clients.

retire_player accepts reason free-text without whitelist — RetirePlayerRequest should use Literal['contusao','estafe','outro'] to prevent junk values reaching the leaderboard badge switch (currently unknown reasons render as 'CONTUSÃO' by default in RotatingPanel.jsx line 229).

rotating_next_round after retire may block on 'múltiplo de 4' when qualifiers are 6/2 remaining — same limitation flagged in iteration_5. With retires this becomes more likely in real tournaments. Consider byes/wildcards.

suggestByCampaign on RotatingPanel.jsx uses live-computed teamPoints minus current inputs — but at tournament start both teams have 0 pts and the user is only shown a small toast; consider adding a tie-breaker suggestion using head-to-head or seed order rather than just erroring out.

MatchRow useEffect dependencies (line 252) reset local a/b/winner when props change — this can wipe user's in-progress input if a parallel WS event or re-fetch fires while typing. Consider guarding with dirty-flag.

retire_player only marks registrations retired but does NOT auto-forfeit the current match (score/winner stays as-is). If the current match is unfinished the admin must still enter a placeholder — document expected behavior or auto-set winner to the opponent team on retire.

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest: creates 2 signup tenants (rrA/rrB) and 8 seeded synthetic regs per test via direct mongo (payment_status='free', mode='individual'); teardown removes users, tenants, regs, matches, teams, groups, competitions. Frontend flow: one-off /tmp/seed_rot_fe.py logged in as super admin, created a duplas_rotativas competition_type + competition + 8 free regs, drew groups via API, then cleaned up manually via mongo after UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite for these features: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_rotating_retire.py -v -o addopts=''` (7 tests, ~4s). It reuses the direct-mongo seed pattern from iteration_5 (motor + AsyncIOMotorClient, bypasses Stripe). Regression of iteration_5 test file (test_rotating_doubles.py) still passes untouched. RetirePlayerRequest reason accepts arbitrary strings — no enum guard. rotating_next_round filters retired regs on the FIRST KO round (from leaderboard) AND on subsequent rounds (retired_map lookup on qualifiers). Frontend RotatingPanel.jsx now has retire dialog + tie detection: needsManualWinner=(score_a==score_b>0 && !winner); suggestByCampaign uses teamPoints(team_id) - currentScore to exclude the tied match. For the 'Campanhas empatadas' branch a Sonner error toast is emitted (matched via body innerText). If you need to test suggest-by-campaign actually picking a winner, first score other group matches so the campaigns differ, then trigger a fresh 5/5 tie in an unscored match.
rca of the issue: N/A — features work as specified. Minor DX observations noted in critical_code_review_comments.
